description: This file defines a React component 'RegenerateKeyModal' used for regenerating API keys within a UI modal. It manages form inputs, handles API calls to regenerate keys, updates access tokens, and displays regenerated key information.

classes.name: RegenerateKeyModal
classes.description: A React functional component for regenerating API keys, managing state and side effects related to key regeneration, and rendering a modal with key information and actions.

methods.name: calculateNewExpiryTime
methods.description: Calculates a new expiry date based on a duration string with suffixes ('s', 'h', 'd') and returns it as a localized string.

methods.name: handleRegenerateKey
methods.description: Handles the process of calling the API to regenerate the key, updating state, and managing access tokens.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Resets state and closes the modal.
